exposure: age of neonate at admission (3-5 h)
cohort: The study included 249 neonates (83 cases with hypoglycemia and 166 controls) admitted to neonatal intensive care units of public hospitals in Wolaita Zone, Southern Ethiopia.
finding: The study found that preterm neonates, neonates admitted at 3-5 hours of age, hypothermia, late initiation of breastfeeding, mode of delivery, and small for gestational age were significantly associated with neonatal hypoglycemia.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as a significant determinant of neonatal hypoglycemia (AOR 5.034, 95% CI 1.688-15.011).
